Forward get result unchanged, including all T/PP/RESUME/DONE/ERR/EOF, timeout and other exceptions; delegate queue put and any used methods, do not create another reader. Preserve through generator close and DONE drain; restore the queue reference in finally. Reject any STAT association lacking an active owned request. Keep capture failure separately fail-closed, never swallow primary error. This is a proposal requiring actual source integration review, not yet proven safe.
